goal: Implement the approved HomeAgent roof-and-intelligent-spark brand system across verified source assets, responsive raster assets, Web surfaces, Feishu avatar download, and macOS packaging without changing user data or existing Feishu identities.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SVG and responsive PNG assets match the approved geometry and palette and pass offline verification.
Admin and setup surfaces use one shared accessible brand component and no longer use the old brand symbols.
Feishu avatar downloads locally through a fixed route and remains a manual upload.
macOS bundles contain and reference HomeAgent.icns and include the avatar resource.
Targeted tests, typecheck, full tests, and visual acceptance checks pass.

tasks.title: Add canonical SVG assets and static validation
tasks.summary: Create approved source SVGs, brand documentation, and offline safety and palette verification.
acceptance_criteria: Full and glyph SVGs match the approved roof and intelligent spark system.
Unsafe SVG content and off-palette colors are rejected.
Brand source documentation defines responsive and generation rules.
validation_results: bun run verify:brand: verified 2 canonical assets.
evidence: High-resolution full mark and glyph renders match the approved roof-and-intelligent-spark design.
Actual SVG scan contains only approved colors and no forbidden active content.

tasks.title: Add responsive PNG and macOS iconset assets
tasks.summary: Render and commit deterministic avatar and AppIcon PNG derivatives and extend asset verification.
acceptance_criteria: Feishu avatar is a valid 512px PNG within the circular safe area.
Every iconset PNG exists at the required dimensions.
Offline verifier rejects malformed or mismatched PNGs.
validation_results: Independent review passed for responsive artwork, file dimensions, color space, alpha behavior, and circular crop.
evidence: Independent pixel review measured avatar critical geometry radius at 185.7px, within the 204.8px circular safe radius.

tasks.title: Create the shared Web brand component
tasks.summary: Inline verified canonical SVG through one typed accessible Hono component.
acceptance_criteria: Full, dark, mono, decorative, and responsive behaviors are observable through the public component.
Output contains no external references, scripts, or old symbols.
validation_results: Independent API and injection-safety review passed.
evidence: Independent review confirmed only verified static SVG constants enter raw HTML; caller labels remain Hono-escaped and numeric sizes are runtime-validated.

tasks.title: Replace admin and setup brand marks
tasks.summary: Use the shared component in the admin rail, setup flow, and restarting screen while preserving behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All brand regions use the shared component.
Old brain and wave symbols are absent from brand regions.
Navigation and setup behavior remain unchanged.
validation_results: Independent review confirmed shared component reuse, accessible wordmarks, and removal of old brand symbols.
evidence: Independent visual review passed on desktop admin, 390px mobile admin, and setup surfaces.

tasks.title: Provide the fixed local Feishu avatar download
tasks.summary: Resolve a fixed brand asset path, serve it locally, and expose honest manual-upload guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed download returns exact PNG bytes and stable headers.
No request-controlled path is read.
Missing assets show an explicit error and existing apps are not mutated.
validation_results: 104 focused tests and typecheck passed; live download matched committed SHA-256.
evidence: Browser verified manual upload copy and stable download attributes.

tasks.title: Wire macOS icon and bundle resources
tasks.summary: Generate HomeAgent.icns with iconutil, copy avatar resources, and enforce bundle checks.
acceptance_criteria: Info.plist declares the HomeAgent icon.
Build output includes icns and avatar resources.
Smoke checks fail when either asset is missing or unreferenced.
validation_results: 4 focused tests, arm64 dry-run, and typecheck passed.
evidence: Build plan and smoke checks require the icon, avatar, and plist reference.

tasks.title: Complete cross-surface verification and release notes
tasks.summary: Add readiness gates, documentation, full automated checks, and the approved visual matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Beta readiness includes offline brand verification.
Release docs describe macOS and manual Feishu checks truthfully.
Full automated and visual acceptance criteria pass.
validation_results: Targeted suites passed; full suite 792 passed, 23 failed, 9 skipped on Windows.
evidence: 16, 128, 512, and 1024px assets visually inspected; browser surfaces were previously reviewed.
